name: jev-save
description: Runtime efficiency guard for coding agents: Jev judges each tool call for redundancy, necessity and scope before it runs. Built on jev-guard.

interface.shortDescription: Skip nothing by guess; stop repeating what is already verified
interface.longDescription: Before a tool call runs, Jev is asked whether it is still necessary, whether it repeats a check that is still valid, and whether it widens the user's request. Redundant checks and scope creep get a short corrective message; risky calls keep jev-guard's security gate. Shadow mode by default: it records what it would have said until you turn enforcement on.
